prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production source sprite atlas for a top-down pixel-art overworld fog overlay, NOT a finished landscape. Draw SIX DIFFERENT isolated shallow fog-bank silhouettes in a strict 2-column by 3-row atlas, equal cells, roomy solid pure #ff00ff magenta gutters and background. No text, no frames. Each bank fills most of its cell width and about half its cell height. Shapes: wide low ragged interleaving fog shoals and broken ribbons, asymmetrical flattened lobes with tapering fingers and open magenta channels; broad flat irregular strata, not fluffy clouds or mountain crests. Vary length, internal gaps, and contour greatly in all six cells. A bank is roughly 85-135 native pixels wide and 18-38 native pixels high. Draw at large resolution as deliberate enlarged square-pixel art, to be reduced later. FOUR FLAT OPAQUE colours ONLY inside the fog: subdued blue-grey #adbfc5 at thin lower-right contours, mist grey #c8d6d8 body, pale grey-white #e1e8e6 lit strata, ivory-white #f1f3eb small top-left highlights. Top-left light. The outer region is usually the darkest grey and highlight layers sit inside it. Stepped squared cluster boundaries, one-native-pixel outline weight, clean substantial connected clusters, broad irregular horizontal breaks. No smooth transparency or opacity gradient; the processing stage will assign fixed alpha levels. Avoid rounded vector curves, black outlines, dithering, isolated specks, dots, noise, blur, airbrush, haze, ground, terrain, shadows, objects. Pure magenta must show between banks and through openings. The six fog drawings must be quiet irregular low banks, no repeated identical wave motifs. Square canvas.

Use case: stylized-concept. Draw a production sprite atlas for low ground fog in a top-down pixel RPG. SIX unique isolated fog banks in 2 columns x 3 rows, all on solid opaque pure #ff00ff magenta, with clear magenta gutters. No text or borders. Each is long and low, roughly 4:1 width:height, formed from quietly interlaced horizontal strata, interrupted by irregular magenta gaps. NOT clouds, NOT smoke, NOT waves or hooked curls. Prefer long nearly horizontal narrow shelves, uneven branching tapered ends, a mix of broad quiet masses and thin shredded fringes. Some banks split into two connected lobes; vary every drawing so they can overlap without identical landmarks. Draw in enlarged crisp pixel-art blocks, with squared stair steps on contours; no rounds or antialiasing. FOUR flat fog colours only: #adbfc5 deepest contour in a thin lower-right line, #c8d6d8 main fog body, #e1e8e6 pale lit strata, #f1f3eb restrained top-left highlights. Inside opaque painted shapes only, do not paint translucent smoke. Keep the outer perimeter mostly the darker low-value grey with the bright layers inset. Interior cutouts show solid magenta. Native intent 90-150 px wide and 20-35 px tall per bank. No scattered tiny dots, no grain, no dithering, no airbrush, no gradients, no ground or objects. Draw at a large square canvas resolution. The six silhouettes should look softly layered because of their irregular connected pixel shapes, never because of blur.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated pixel-art heat shimmer stroke atlas for a top-down RPG map. Draw EIGHT different individual, very thin horizontal wavy shimmer strokes in a 2-column by 4-row atlas. Solid opaque pure #ff00ff magenta background, large completely magenta gutters, no text, no boxes. Each stroke is one very long low gently wavering irregular line with one or two small interrupted sections. All eight have different lengths, flat intervals and shallow kinks, never a repeating sine-wave pattern. Native intent about 35-80 pixels wide, 1-2 pixels line thickness, waviness only 1-3 pixels tall. Draw large with crisp square enlarged pixels. No steep arcs, no curls, no loops, no arrows. Colours only pale warm ivory #fff4d4 with a subtle muted straw #e7cf9b lower pixel, plus a few light gold-white #fff9e8 pixels on the upper-left edges. Thin airy refraction-like lines, no broad filled ribbons. Draw colours fully opaque on magenta; fixed low alpha will be applied in processing. There is no terrain, sun, shadow, landscape, particles, specks, noise or grain. No blur, smooth gradient, airbrush or transparency. The strokes should be so slight that at native scale their shape reads as a quiet warm horizontal ripple, not a decorative texture. Square canvas.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a source atlas of EIGHT distinct heat-refraction shimmer lines for a square-grid top-down pixel RPG map. 2 columns x 4 rows; each individual line in its own cell, on pure flat opaque #ff00ff magenta, no labels. Narrow nearly horizontal low irregular wavering lines, about 40-90 native pixels long, only 1 native pixel thick (occasionally two where a lower tint meets). Draw in enlarged squared pixel blocks with clear native steps. Some lines taper and break once, some gently rise one pixel then flatten, others descend one pixel then flatten; no repeating waveform, no looping swirls. Width:height aspect of each complete wavering line about 20:1 or greater. Mostly warm ivory #fff4d4, restrained gold #e7cf9b along a few lower-right pixels, a little #fff9e8 top-left light. Flat solid colours; opaque source on magenta, translucent final output handled later. Keep generous magenta between all eight lines, and keep all endpoints well clear of atlas borders. No tiny disconnected single-pixel dots, noise, blurs, glow, airbrush, round edges, terrain, sun, objects, shadows, typography or outline boxes. An understated temperature ripple, never a thick ribbon or a water wave. Square high-resolution source canvas.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: four DRAWN pixel-cluster fog-bank edge fade masks. Draw a tall stack of FOUR SEPARATE wide horizontal rectangular strips on a square solid #ff00ff magenta canvas, with narrow pure magenta gutters between strips. Every strip has exact straight full-width TOP edge; bottom is a ragged open feathered transition into magenta. Each strip width:height about 4:1. The image will be converted to a discrete-alpha mask for fog, so use ONLY flat shades #ffffff, #cccccc, #999999, #666666, #333333 and pure #ff00ff. Inside each strip: the uppermost 1/6 of height is solid white from left to right, with no holes; below it white thins into large irregular interlocking step-edged light grey clusters, then medium grey, dark grey, very dark grey, then completely magenta at the bottom. Most of the bottom eighth is clear magenta. Boundaries between the flat grey levels are varied drawn shallow ragged filaments, with little connected fingers and openings, never straight horizontal bands. Avoid repeated bumps, rounded contours, disconnected dots, speckles, dithering, airbrush, smooth gradient and noise. Each of the four strips needs a different irregular contour, natural layered wisps rather than a sawtooth rhythm. All pixels square, draw large crisp pixel art with block steps suitable for reducing each strip to 192x48. The TOP white plateau must reach exactly both side boundaries. No text, numbers, borders, shadows, landscape or objects.

Use case: stylized-concept. Draw a fog-edge mask atlas: FOUR DIFFERENT very wide horizontal strips stacked in four equally tall rows on a square canvas. Pure solid #ff00ff magenta background and gutters. Each strip approximately 4:1 width to height. The upper boundary is a dead straight full-width horizontal edge with a white band covering its top 15 percent. From that white inner plateau downwards, paint several broad interlocking shredded horizontal mist layers: white #ffffff, light grey #cccccc, mid grey #999999, dark grey #666666, charcoal #333333, then ragged fully magenta gaps near the bottom. FLAT colours ONLY, no blend, no gradient. These are source masks to be palette-reduced and used as discrete opacity caps; they are not visible dark fog. The light-to-dark layer boundaries must have shallow long irregular pixel fingers, a few channels, and uneven heights. Keep the outermost tips sparse and thin, ending in magenta with a clear magenta margin. No regular scallops, no drips, no cloud lobes, no noisy specks. Large deliberate crisp square pixel clusters. Each of the four strips has a unique quiet natural irregular outline and internal layer structure, while the top white plateau has no gaps all the way left to right. Draw at large size to reduce to 192x48 per strip. No labels, objects, terrain, outline frame or smooth curves.
